fact: At the 24 June 2026 closing of eGabon-SIS, ANINF said its technical teams accompanied the design, integration, deployment and securing of the solutions, including the health information system in 13 pilot hospitals.
title: eGABON-SIS : UNE RÉUSSITE COLLECTIVE PORTÉE PAR L'EXPERTISE TECHNIQUE NATIONALE
publisher: Agence Nationale des Infrastructures Numériques et des Fréquences (ANINF)
